spans.s: 1. अ॑ह ind. (as a particle implying ascertainment, affirmation, certainty, &c.) surely, certainly, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.
(as explaining, defining) namely, ŚBr.
(as admitting, limiting, &c.) it is true, I grant, granted, indeed, at least, ŚBr. [For the rules of accentuation necessitated in a phrase by the particle अ॑ह cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 24 seqq.]
(also) a particle answering to ह in a preceding sentence (ह — अह = μὲν — δέ), Gaṇar.
2. अ॑ह n. (only Ved.; nom. pl. अ॑हा, RV.; AV.; gen. pl. अ॑हानाम्, RV. viii, 22, 13) = अ॑हर्, q.v., a day
often ifc. m(अह॑). (e.g. द्वादशाह॑, त्र्य्-अह॑, षड्-अह॑, &c.) or n. (e.g. पुण्याह॑, भद्राह॑, and सुदिनाह)
See also अह्न s.v.
